## TemplateManager.getMedia() method

Gets compiled media template data.

**Signature:**

```typescript
getMedia(key: string, baseId?: string, language?: string, data?: Record<string, any>): ReturnType<ICompiledTemplate[`media`][`default`][`default`]>;
```

**Returns:**

ReturnType&lt;ICompiledTemplate\[\`media\`\]\[\`default\`\]\[\`default\`\]&gt;

Media object containing type, src, and caption

## Remarks

Retrieves the compiled media function for the specified template and language, then executes it with the provided data to generate the media payload.

## Example


```typescript
const media = tm.getMedia("photo-page", "default", "en", {photoUrl: "..."})}
// => {type: "photo", src: "...", caption: "..."}
```
